# exactl command reference

## Work

- [request](request.md): Create and follow requests for Exaix agents and flows
- [plan](plan.md): Review and decide AI-generated plans
- [review](review.md): Review the output that agents produce
- [approval](approval.md): Decide what waits for a human

## Definitions

- [flow](flow.md): Define and run multi-agent flows
- [blueprint](blueprint.md): Manage the blueprints of agent roles
- [skill](skill.md): Manage procedural skills
- [portal](portal.md): Manage external project portals

## Operations

- [daemon](daemon.md): Control the Exaix daemon
- [memory](memory.md): Read and manage the memory banks
- [git](git.md): Inspect the repositories that the agents work in
- [mcp](mcp.md): Run the MCP server and call external MCP servers
- [config](config.md): View and change the Exaix configuration
- [log](log.md): Read the activity journal and the cost of the LLM calls
- [model](model.md): Inspect the model registry and choose the models
- [eval](eval.md): Run evaluation scenarios and read their history

## System

- [completion](completion.md): Print shell completion scripts

## Other

- [dashboard](dashboard.md): Open the interactive dashboard
- [version](version.md): Show the binary and workspace schema versions
- [doctor](doctor.md): Check the health of the installation

## Global options

- `-o, --output <format>`: Output format: table, json, jsonl, md, text (type: output-format)
- `--json`: Output as JSON (same as -o json)
- `-q, --quiet`: Print only ids in human formats
- `--no-color`: Disable colored output
- `--no-input`: Never prompt; fail when input is needed
- `-y, --yes`: Confirm destructive actions without prompting
